license.dataStatement: Supporting information available without restriction; credit article and authors.

priorExposure.note: Aggregates already inspected; this partition is not a pristine blind holdout and cannot erase historical exposure.

partitionRule: Odd replica suffixes: development; even: reserved. All frames and final graph of a replica stay together. Outcome-independent rule, fixed after inventory exposure.

measurements.timeOrigin: Ordinal only: (frame-1)*20 min. Latency alignment and physical compatibility must be verified before comparison.
measurements.meshedness: Not computed: connected/simple/planar and peripheral-node conventions need verification.
measurements.physicalLengthAreaVolume: Not computed; supplement units and chamber conventions not yet verified.

evaluation.unit: Replica, not frame. Final graph and final frame are separate products, never pooled as independent observations.
metrics: MAE by metric/group, with replica weighting
Conditional simulation-ensemble coverage with a declared level
evaluation.passThresholds: No biological pass threshold invented. Report deviations; predictive protocol must be fixed before reserved evaluation.
evaluation.nextGate: Freeze compatible simulation protocol, parameters, seeds and predictions before opening reserved metrics. Any later adjustment consumes that evaluation.
